# Shared Story Format (nopCommerce)

## User Story
As a [role - e.g. store admin, customer, guest]
I want [capability]
So that [business value]

## Acceptance Criteria
Use Given-When-Then and keep each criterion testable and measurable.

## nopCommerce Context Line (add when relevant)
Where it changes what "testable" means, note:
- Target nopCommerce version
- Storefront, admin, or both
- Whether it depends on an existing plugin or third-party integration

## Traceability
Each story must map to:
- Requirement statements
- Design elements (including the placement decision: new plugin / extension / core override / core modification)
- Implementation tasks
